title: Check if Windows uses UEFI or Legacy BIOS
summary: Knowing your Windows boot mode is essential for configuring the Linux bootloader correctly. UEFI requires GPT, while Legacy BIOS requires MBR.

steps.explain: Open the Run dialog in Windows.
Type msinfo32 and press Enter to open System Information.
In the System Summary, look for 'BIOS Mode'. 'UEFI' means UEFI/GPT, 'Legacy' means BIOS/MBR.
steps.gui: Check the value of 'BIOS Mode' in the right pane.
